final_message:
Fixed. In `render_invoice` (`billing/render.py`), the "Amount due" line called `format_amount(currency, invoice["amount_due"])`, with the arguments swapped. The currency check in `format_amount` then rejected the amount as `unsupported currency: 0`. I put the arguments back in the right order.

I added your test as `tests/test_render_invoice.py`. The full suite passes (25 tests). I also wrote `answer.json` in the repository root:

```json
{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}
```

steps.command: cat billing/render.py && grep -rn "unsupported currency" billing && ls billing

sed -i 's/format_amount(currency, invoice\["amount_due"\])/format_amount(invoice["amount_due"], currency)/' billing/render.py && echo '{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

ls tests && cat > tests/test_render_invoice.py <<'EOF'
from billing.render import render_invoice


def test_render_invoice(world):
    from billing import tax

    tax.set_tax_rate(world.ctx, "US-CA", 825, "CA")
    cus = world.customer(region="US-CA")
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    text = render_invoice(world.ctx, inv)
    assert "Invoice INV-00001" in text
    assert "Tax (8.25%)" in text
    assert "$10.82" in text
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8
